latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of llmwiki skill.

- Adds an LLM-powered assistant for managing a knowledge wiki in Obsidian.
- Supports three main sub-commands: ingest (add content), query (ask questions), and health (audit quality).
- Enables automatic routing to delegate tasks based on user input.
- Provides help and usage instructions for all available commands.
- Designed to streamline personal knowledge base curation and maintenance.
